title: CORE DataSource
description: Configuration for a data source that feeds structured data into a CORE pipeline. Currently supports MQTT brokers. The 'element' field references an Element by versioned CORE URN — this constraint is enforced in the DataSet context.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSource.

connectionType.description: Protocol used by this data source.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the Element that describes the payload format.

topic.description: MQTT topic to subscribe to. Wildcards (+, #) are supported.

clientId.description: Optional MQTT client ID. Auto-generated if omitted.

qos.description: MQTT Quality of Service level: 0 = at most once, 1 = at least once, 2 = exactly once.

jdbcUrl.description: JDBC connection URL for database-backed lookup sources.

password.description: Database login password. Do not commit plaintext credentials.

lookupTable.description: Database table used for enrichment lookups.

lookupKey.description: Database key column used for enrichment lookups.

url.description: HTTP endpoint URL for HTTP sources.
